title: Delays in Covid shots for kids is latest bid by Trump officials to restrict vaccines
summary_full: Administration is holding back Covid vaccines for all children in at least 11 states and one US territoryThe Trump administration is holding back Covid vaccines for all children in at least 11 states and one US territory, and officials have not indicated when or whether the shots will become available.It’s the latest step by top officials to restrict vaccines in America – and it sets a precedent for holding back other immunizations, experts said.
